battle.name: 剛果危機
battle.theater: 剛果河上游與加丹加銅礦帶
battle.brief: 1960年6月30日剛果自治邦宣告獨立，七月首都暴動與殖民警衛隊兵變迫使比利時出兵干預，加丹加隨即宣布獨立，聯合國部隊進駐銅礦帶與輸油管線走廊。全役爭奪的是內陸鐵路、公路與管線的控制權，卡面英國鐵甲艦為一八六二年的海上裝甲戰艦，與本役相隔近百年，從未進入剛果內陸。

kit.name: 鐵甲艦
kit.history: 木殼外面包了鐵。裝甲第一次比砲更難對付，砲塔的設計從此繞著它轉。

countries: 1960年6月30日比屬剛果自治邦宣告獨立之後，戰場上迅速形成三個互相對抗的陣營。以帕特里斯·盧蒙博為總理、喬瑟夫-德西雷·卡薩武布為總統的剛果中央政府，軍隊是同年8月由殖民警衛隊與加丹加守備隊合併而成的剛果國民軍，官兵多為前治安警察，裝備與訓練都停留在殖民警隊層次；國民大會在眾議院只有過半席位，中央政權對外省幾乎沒有實際控制力。以莫伊塞·楚姆貝為總統、駐節伊利莎白維爾的加丹加分離政府，擁有加丹加鄉村守備隊、數百名歐洲傭兵與飛行員，其開支在銅價高位時靠聯合礦業公司支付的特許權使用費維持，資金比中央政府充裕。比利時是第三方面，自1959年底起即以「志願軍」為名留駐數千人員，衝突爆發後派出傘兵與砲兵，指揮體系由駐剛果軍團與埃米爾·讓森中將率領的「國際部隊」組成，但部隊規模與任務範圍長期受到聯合國與北約盟國質疑。聯合國方面，安理會先後以第143、145、169號決議要求比利時撤軍並授權組成聯合國剛果行動，最多時集結約兩萬人，由愛爾蘭、衣索比亞、加納、印度、摩洛哥、突尼西亞等國的步兵群組成，另有美軍提供空運、比利時提供砲兵與工兵技術支援，而卡坦加背後則有法國、南羅得西亞與葡萄牙屬地等邊境方向的支援管道。
countriesEn: When the Belgian Congo declared its independence on 30 June 1960, three mutually hostile camps appeared on the battlefield within weeks. The central Congolese government, headed by Prime Minister Patrice Lumumba and President Joseph-Désiré Kasavubu, fielded an army formed in August that year by merging the colonial Force Publique with the Katangese gendarmerie, its ranks made up largely of former constables whose equipment and training stayed at the level of a colonial police force; the National Assembly held only a slim majority in the Chamber of Representatives, and the central government exercised almost no real control over the provinces. The Katanga secessionist government, with Moïse Tshombe as president seated in Élisabethville, had the Katangese gendarmerie, several hundred European mercenaries and pilots, and its expenditure, with copper prices high, was underwritten by the concession payments of the Union Minière du Haut-Katanga, which gave it far more money than the central government had. Belgium was the third party: from late 1959 it had already kept several thousand men on the ground as 'volunteers', and after the fighting broke out it sent paratroopers and artillery, the command structure running through the army corps in the Congo and through the 'International Force' led by Lieutenant General Émile Janssens, though the size of the deployment and the scope of the mission were repeatedly questioned by the United Nations and by NATO allies. On the United Nations side, Security Council resolutions 143, 145 and 169 called on Belgium to withdraw and authorised the formation of the United Nations Operation in the Congo, which at its height assembled about twenty thousand men in infantry groupments drawn from Ireland, Ethiopia, Ghana, India, Morocco, Tunisia and other states, with American airlift and Belgian artillery and engineering support alongside them; behind Katanga ran a support line pointing toward France, Southern Rhodesia and the Portuguese territories on the Angolan frontier.
people: 改變剛果命運的決策幾乎都出自幾個名字。帕特里斯·盧蒙博以民族主義政黨領袖身份在1960年6月的大選中勝出，7月出任總理，因為國民大會在眾議院未能取得過半，他必須倚靠總統的信任才能運作，卻很快因清洗加丹加政府的軍隊與拒絕外國軍事援助而與卡薩武布決裂。喬瑟夫-德西雷·卡薩武布是從民族主義陣營裡脫離出來的反對派，他靠議會選票當上國家象徵，再用軍隊人事權與盧蒙博周旋。莫伊塞·楚姆貝在1960年7月先任加丹加總理、9月轉任總統，把加丹加的戰爭當成一場民族自決運動，實際運作則依靠比利時與法國的技術顧問以及一批有實戰經驗的歐洲傭兵。軍人莫布圖·塞西·加邦加在1960年11月24日發動政變，推倒盧蒙博，此後以國家軍隊最高權威的身份長期控制軍方，這次政變背後有美方的默許。聯合國秘書長達格·哈馬斯柯爾德在1961年9月18日飛赴恩多拉斡旋時座機墜毀身亡，連同十餘名隨行人員一併罹難，成為這場危機最沉痛的符號。聯合國部隊的指揮先後由愛爾蘭准將西恩·麥克因與加納准將恩內斯克里夫接任，美方由國務卿杜勒斯與艾森豪威爾總統主導政策，東線另有法國傭兵隊長傑拉爾·德納爾，以及切·格瓦拉在1964年底至1965年初帶隊進入東部邊境。
peopleEn: Almost every decision that shaped Congo's fate came from a handful of men. Patrice Lumumba, leader of the nationalist movement, won the elections of June 1960 and became prime minister in July; because his party did not hold a majority in the Chamber, he could govern only on the president's confidence, and he was quickly at odds with Kasavubu over purging the Katangese government from the army and over refusing foreign military aid. Joseph-Désiré Kasavubu was the opposition man who had split away from the nationalist movement: he became the symbol of the state on the strength of parliamentary votes and then used his control of army appointments to play against Lumumba. Moïse Tshombe was prime minister of Katanga in July 1960 and became its president in September, treating the Katanga war as a movement of national self-determination, while the actual running of the secession rested on Belgian and French technical advisers and on a body of European mercenaries with real combat experience. The soldier Mobutu Sese Seko carried out the coup of 24 November 1960 that brought Lumumba down, and thereafter held the highest authority in the national army for decades, with the American authorities acquiescing in that coup. The United Nations Secretary-General Dag Hammarskjöld was killed on 18 September 1961 when his aircraft crashed on the way to Ndola for mediation, together with more than ten of his companions, and became the most grievous symbol of the crisis. The United Nations force was commanded first by the Irish Brigadier Sean Mac Eoin and later by the Ghanaian Brigadier Emmanuel Erskine, American policy was directed by Secretary of State John Foster Dulles and by President Eisenhower, and on the eastern front there were the French mercenary commander Gérard Denard and Che Guevara, who brought his men into the eastern borderlands at the end of 1964 and in early 1965.
kits: 卡面這件鐵甲艦屬十九世紀六十年代的裝甲戰艦：木製船殼外面加上一圈鍛鐵裝甲帶，裝甲厚度遠超同時代木殼艦炮彈所能穿透的極限，炮位改為封閉式旋轉炮塔，炮管只能從塔壁的射孔伸出，於是炮塔的轉向、重量與後坐裝置全部要繞著裝甲厚度來設計，砲塔對準裝甲的時代就這樣開始。一八六二年前後英國先後有數艘同類艦下水，法國與美國南北戰爭的兩造也在同一年各造出裝甲艦，證明這種船型是海上防禦與岸轟的現實答案。但剛果是內陸國家，沒有海軍也沒有外海；剛果河雖可自大西洋沿岸的馬塔迪港一帶通航至金沙薩以上，卡薩伊河與上游支流亦有淺水航段，卻沒有可供裝甲艦活動的水域，這件兵器因此不可能出現在本場戰役的任何一段河道。真正在剛果水域活動的是小型內河艦艇：殖民時期比利時留下數艘武裝汽艇與內河巡邏艇，獨立後於1961年編入新成立的剛果海軍，任務是沿剛果河巡邏、護航與攔截，聯合國部隊本身則完全沒有海上單位。陸戰裝備方面，中央政府的剛果國民軍以FN MAG中型通用機槍、FN-41步槍、卡賓槍與迫擊砲為主，蘇聯及後來經中東運入的AK-47成為游擊隊的常見步槍；加丹加方面有MiG-17與MiG-21戰鬥機，配合同樣蘇聯血統的教練機改裝的地面攻擊機，以及自法國引進的Fouga Magister雙座輕型攻擊機；剛果空軍另得到數架T-6教練機與幾架DC-3型運輸機，而美方與中央情報局使用B-25 Mitchell轟炸機與T-6執行對地攻擊與偵察，空運主力是C-119與C-130。
kitsEn: The ironclad on the card belongs to the armoured warships of the 1860s: a wooden hull with a belt of wrought-iron armour laid over it, armour far thicker than the shells of the contemporary wooden warships could punch, and the guns moved into enclosed rotating turrets whose barrels could only reach out through ports in the turret wall, so that the turning, the weight and the recoil gear of the turret all had to be designed around the thickness of the armour; that is how the era of the turret designed against armour began. Around 1862 Britain had several such ships in the water, and France and the two sides of the American Civil War each built an armoured vessel in the same year, which proved that this hull form was the practical answer to sea defence and to bombardment of shore positions. But the Congo is a landlocked country with no navy and no open sea; the Congo River is navigable from the Atlantic at Matadi up past Kinshasa, and the Kasai and the upper tributaries have shallow reaches as well, yet there is no water in which an ironclad could have operated, and this weapon therefore cannot have appeared on any stretch of river in this war. What actually moved on Congolese waters were small river craft: a few armed launches and river patrol boats left over from the colonial Belgian river flotilla, which after independence were taken into the newly raised Congolese Navy in 1961 for river patrolling, escort and interdiction, the United Nations force itself having no maritime element at all. On land, the central government's Armée Nationale Congolaise was armed chiefly with the FN MAG general-purpose machine gun, the FN-41 rifle, carbines and mortars, while AK-47s supplied by the Soviet Union and later routed in through the Middle East became the common weapon of the insurgents; Katanga fielded MiG-17 and MiG-21 fighters together with ground-attack conversions of trainer aircraft of Soviet origin, and the French-supplied Fouga Magister light attack aircraft; the Congolese air force also acquired a handful of T-6 trainers and several DC-3 transports, while the Americans and the Central Intelligence Agency used B-25 Mitchell bombers and T-6 aircraft for ground attack and reconnaissance, with the C-119 and the C-130 carrying the lift.
tactics: 1960年7月的首都保衛戰決定了整場危機的走向。比利時部隊以空降兵迅速控制伊利莎白港機場，並在首都各路口設置路障與檢查站，護送西方僑民撤離；兵變的治安警察在卡薩武布的默許下被解除武裝並整編，剛果國民軍雖告成立，各營之間卻缺乏統一指揮與後勤，實際上不過是把兩支互相懷疑的隊伍並排放在同一個番號之下。聯合國部隊入駐後的主要任務由「打擊卡坦加」轉為「維持走廊」：保護伊利莎白維爾至金沙薩的鐵路、沿銅礦帶通往馬塔迪港的輸油管線，以及卡米納與阿爾貝托維爾等內陸機場，手段是以步兵群佔據據點、封鎖道路、護送卡車隊與維修隊；1960年11月28日ONUC在耶多特維爾與科隆維爾一帶遭卡坦加游擊隊包圍而被迫撤回，說明以分散小分隊守據點的做法在這種地形上極易被切斷。1961年之後聯合國改以空軍支援地面行動，1960年12月25日與1962年1月6日兩度由出動機群攻擊伊利莎白維爾機場上的卡坦加飛機，並以巡邏隊沿鐵路搜索游擊隊殘部。1962年卡坦加轉守為攻，部隊向聯軍陣地推進，是全役聯合國地面部隊最吃重的一段，局勢在1963年1月以停戰與楚姆貝投降告一段落。1964至1965年戰線轉入東部山區，Simba武裝在坦噶尼卡與烏干達邊境獲得補給，政府軍在比利時、美國空中支援與西方傭兵協助下沿交通線切斷其後勤，切·格瓦拉的小股游擊隊則示範另一種做法：以小隊深入鄉村、動員農民、避免佔領城市，結果在布卡武與基桑加尼之間受挫。
tacticsEn: The fighting for the capital in July 1960 set the course of the whole crisis. Belgian airborne troops seized the airport at Léopoldville within days and set up barricades and checkpoints at the approaches to the city, escorting the Western residents out; the mutinous constabulary was disarmed and reorganised with the connivance of Kasavubu, and although the Armée Nationale Congolaise was duly proclaimed, its battalions lacked a common command and common logistics, and in practice amounted to two mutually suspicious bodies of men filed under a single designation. Once the United Nations force was in the country its main task turned from 'beating Katanga' into 'holding the corridor': protecting the railway from Élisabethville to Kinshasa, the pipeline that ran from the copper belt down to the port of Matadi, and the inland airfields of Kamina and Albertville, by occupying posts with infantry groupments, sealing the roads, and escorting truck convoys and repair parties. On 28 November 1960 ONUC was surrounded by Katangese irregulars at Jadotville and Colonelville and had to withdraw, which showed how easily small scattered posts could be cut off in that country. From 1961 the United Nations shifted to supporting the ground with its air force: on 25 December 1960 and again on 6 January 1962 its aircraft attacked the Katangese machines parked at the Élisabethville airfield, while patrols searched the railway line for the remnants of the guerrillas. In 1962 Katanga went on the offensive and pushed towards United Nations positions, the heaviest fighting borne by the UN ground troops in the entire war, and the situation was settled in January 1963 by an armistice and Tshombe's surrender. In 1964 and 1965 the front moved into the eastern highlands, where the Simba forces drew supplies across the Tanganyika and Uganda borders, and the government, with Belgian and American air support and Western mercenaries, cut their supply lines along the transport routes; Che Guevara's small guerrilla bands demonstrated a different method in the same country, pushing small teams into the countryside, mobilising the peasants and avoiding the occupation of towns, and they were checked in the end between Bukavu and Kisangani.
data: 可以引用的數字大致如下。比屬剛果面積約二百三十四萬平方公里，1960年人口約一千五百萬。1960年殖民當局掌握的治安警察約一萬二千人，其中比利時籍軍官與士官約一千名，每營約三個連、每連三十至四十人；獨立後由其改組的剛果國民軍大致沿用同樣編制。比利時在1960年七月至年底的出兵高峰約一萬人，傘兵部隊超過一千五百人。聯合國剛果行動的授權上限先為一萬九千八百一十五人（安理會第169號決議），1961年1月提高至二萬五千人（第219號決議），實際最高兵力約一萬八千至兩萬人，來源包括愛爾蘭、衣索比亞、加納、印度、摩洛哥、突尼西亞、波蘭、瑞典、丹麥、挪威、荷蘭與加拿大等國。戰線上的距離同樣關鍵：伊利莎白維爾至金沙薩的鐵路約一千三百公里，銅礦帶至馬塔迪港的輸油管線長約一千三百公里，首都至寬扎省馬布吉馬伊約二百公里，卡米納與阿爾貝托維爾是內陸僅有的幾個可供大型運輸機起降的機場。1964年政府軍正規兵力約六千至七千人，第5、第6傭兵營合計約一千五百人，古巴部隊投入高峰約一千五百人，剛果空軍可用作攻擊機的T-6只有數架。聯合國部隊至撤軍為止的戰鬥陣亡約四百餘人。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. The Belgian Congo covered about 2.34 million square kilometres and had a population of some fifteen million in 1960. The colonial Force Publique numbered about twelve thousand men in 1960, of whom around one thousand were Belgian officers and NCOs, organised in battalions of about three companies with thirty to forty men to a company; the Armée Nationale Congolaise into which it was converted after independence broadly kept the same organisation. The Belgian deployment peaked at about ten thousand men between July and the end of 1960, of whom more than fifteen hundred were paratroopers. The authorised ceiling of the United Nations operation was first set at 19,815 men by Security Council resolution 169 and raised to twenty-five thousand in January 1961 by resolution 219, while the strength actually reached was some eighteen to twenty thousand, drawn from Ireland, Ethiopia, Ghana, India, Morocco, Tunisia, Poland, Sweden, Denmark, Norway, the Netherlands, Canada and other states. Distances were decisive in the same way: the railway from Élisabethville to Kinshasa ran about 1,300 kilometres, the pipeline from the copper belt to the port of Matadi was about 1,300 kilometres long, the capital lies roughly two hundred kilometres from Mbuji-Mayi in the Bandundu province, and Kamina and Albertville were among the very few inland airfields able to take heavy transport aircraft. In 1964 the government fielded roughly six to seven thousand regular troops, the 5th and 6th Commando together about fifteen hundred men, the Cuban contingent peaked at about fifteen hundred, and the Congolese air force had only a handful of T-6 aircraft available for attack work. The United Nations force lost about four hundred men in action over the life of the operation.
cause: 剛果危機的起因可以分成三層。最外層是殖民統治本身的裂痕：加丹加省因銅礦開採而成為剛果最富的省分，其聯合礦業公司的特許權使用費長期由省政府保留，中央政府無力過問，地方菁英因此產生「我們出錢、卻由中央分錢」的不平；獨立黨派的競逐又使這份不滿有了組織與武裝。其次是獨立的時機與方式：一九六〇年六月三十日的宣告結束得太快，比利時在幾個月內撤走民政官員卻留下軍隊，行政、司法、關稅與鑛產收入的管理同時出現真空；新政府既無預算、無可用軍隊，也沒有能力在幾週內組建全國性的指揮系統。第三層是殖民軍隊內部的矛盾：治安警察中比利時軍官與本地士兵在薪酬、晉升與生活待遇上差距極大，士兵在軍官眼中只是「看守黑人的看守」，而1960年7月8日以後的兵變一旦爆發，雙方都沒有可以收場的語言，再加上加丹加守備隊拒絕解散，使剛果國民軍從一成立就內部分裂。冷戰的介入是最後一層：美國擔心共產主義在剛果立足，也擔心比屬剛果的銅與鈾供應失控，英國與法國則希望維持自己在非洲的既得影響，於是同一場危機在超強的眼中成了可以下注的棋局。
causeEn: The causes of the Congo Crisis can be read in three layers. The outermost is the fracture in colonial rule itself: Katanga, enriched by copper mining, was the richest province in the Congo, the concession payments of the Union Minière were retained by the provincial government where the central authorities could not touch them, and local notables came to resent the arrangement on the grounds that we pay and the centre divides up the money; the competition between the parties of independence gave that resentment an organisation and arms of its own. The second layer is the timing and the manner of independence: the declaration of 30 June 1960 came too fast, Belgium withdrew its civil administrators within a few months while keeping its troops on the ground, and the administration, the courts, the customs and the mining revenues were all left in a vacuum at once; the new government had no budget, no usable army and no capacity to build a national command structure in a matter of weeks. The third layer is the contradiction inside the colonial force: the pay, promotion and living conditions of Belgian officers and local soldiers in the Force Publique were worlds apart, the men were in the officers' eyes only warders of warders, and once the mutiny of 8 July 1960 broke out neither side had any language with which to close it; the refusal of the Katangese gendarmerie to disband then split the new national army from the moment of its creation. The Cold War was the last layer: America feared that communism would take root in the Congo and that the supply of Congolese copper and uranium would slip out of control, while Britain and France wanted to preserve their existing influence in Africa, so that the same crisis became a board on which the great powers could stake a move.
impact: 這場危機的後果遠超出剛果一地。第一，聯合國第一次大規模的維持和平行動由此建立，ONUC的部署方式——多國混編步兵群、依托公路與機場、少作攻城而多保走廊——成為後續聯合國部隊行動的模板，也確立了安理會在主權國家剛取得獨立時介入的方式；哈馬斯柯爾德的座機墜毀在恩多拉，則是聯合國同時背上道義責任與實際風險的開端。第二，剛果的國家整合從此只是名義上的：加丹加分離被平定，中央政府的軍隊卻在戰後長期空殼化，國庫耗盡，國家能力問題被整個留給後人，而軍人干政的傳統在此後數十年裡一再出現。第三，冷戰的代理戰從非洲的邊角展開，美國以中央情報局與傭兵介入，蘇聯與古巴經東非與中東輸送武器與人員，讓剛果的每一次政變都帶上外部勢力的指紋；非洲各國由此警覺到，殖民時代的衝突可以在後殖民時代以新的形式重演，而當時湧入坦噶尼亞、贊比亞與剛果共和國境內的大批剛果難民，也重塑了中部非洲的人口版圖。第四，這條因果鏈在三十年後仍然發揮作用：卡比拉早年在Simba戰爭中的經歷，與一九九〇年代盧安達的局勢、以及一九九四年盧旺達種族滅絕的前因，都能在這幾年裡找到源頭，而一九九七年蒙博托下台之後的持久戰亂，仍是這段歷史的直接後果。
impactEn: The consequences of the crisis reached far beyond the Congo itself. First, the United Nations built its first large-scale peacekeeping operation here, and the way ONUC was deployed — mixed infantry groupments from many countries, leaning on the roads and the airfields, attacking cities seldom and holding corridors often — became the template for later United Nations operations, and it settled the question of how the Security Council would intervene in the days immediately after a sovereign state won its independence; the wreck of Hammarskjöld's aircraft at Ndola marked the moment when the United Nations carried moral responsibility and real risk at the same time. Second, Congolese national integration henceforth existed in name only: the Katanga secession was defeated, but the army of the central government was hollowed out for years afterwards, the treasury was spent, the question of state capacity was passed whole to the next generation, and the tradition of the army making the state reappeared repeatedly over the decades that followed. Third, the proxy war of the Cold War opened in a corner of Africa: American intervention ran through the Central Intelligence Agency and through mercenaries, while the Soviet Union and Cuba moved weapons and men by way of East Africa and the Middle East, so that every Congolese coup carried the fingerprint of an outside power; African states drew the lesson that colonial-era conflicts could be replayed in post-colonial form, and the large flow of Congolese refugees into Tanganyika, Zambia and the Congo Republic itself reshuffled the demographic map of central Africa. Fourth, the chain of causation kept working thirty years later: Kabila's experience in the Simba war, the situation in Rwanda in the 1990s, and the antecedents of the 1994 genocide all trace back to these years, and the protracted wars that followed Mobutu's fall in 1997 are a direct consequence of that history.
result: 以一九六〇至一九六五年的時序看，結局分兩段。第一段是一九六三年一月的停戰：楚姆貝同意解散卡坦加政府與其武裝，聯合國以出售卡坦加資產所得的一億多美元貸款交給剛果中央政府，作為接手礦區的補償，銅礦的特許權收入重新集中到中央，卡坦加的分離架構就此瓦解，楚姆貝被羈押，後於1964年被釋放並在美國與比利時支持下出任中央政府總理。第二段是一九六四至一九六五年的東線戰役：Simba武裝席捲北部與東部數省、攻入斯坦利維爾等城市，政府軍在傭兵、古巴部隊與西方空中支援下花了近一年時間，才把主要武裝驅回東部叢林深處，切·格瓦拉在布卡武一役受挫後於1965年2月撤出剛果，楚姆貝的內閣隨之瓦解，1965年11月24日莫布圖再次政變。就軍事結果而言，剛果中央政府贏得了國家統一的形式與礦產收入，卻沒有一支能用的軍隊和一部能運作的國家機器；聯合國以聯合部隊的代價換來的只是一場沒有和平協議的臨時安排；而在整場危機中最持久、最能左右後世的，反而是那些被視為次要戰場的游擊戰與傭兵戰。
resultEn: Read in sequence from 1960 to 1965, the outcome has two parts. The first is the armistice of January 1963: Tshombe agreed to dissolve the Katangese government and its armed forces, the United Nations handed the central government a loan of more than a hundred million dollars raised from the sale of the Katangan assets as compensation for taking over the mining areas, the concession income from the copper mines was reconcentrated in the centre, the architecture of the secession came apart, Tshombe was taken into custody and was released in 1964 to become prime minister of the central government with American and Belgian support. The second part is the eastern campaign of 1964 and 1965: the Simba fighters swept through several northern and eastern provinces and took cities such as Stanleyville, and it took the government, with mercenaries, Cuban troops and Western air support, the better part of a year to drive the main bodies of the insurgents back into the deep forest of the east; Che Guevara, checked at Bukavu, withdrew from the Congo in February 1965, Tshombe's cabinet then fell apart, and on 24 November 1965 Mobutu carried out another coup. In military terms the central Congolese government won the form of national unity and the mining revenue, but it did not win a usable army or a working state machine; what the United Nations bought with the cost of its joint force was a temporary arrangement with no peace settlement behind it; and the parts of this crisis that proved most durable and most able to shape the later world were precisely the guerrilla and mercenary wars that were treated at the time as secondary theatres.
